In-loop val during training (training log, one reading per 1,000 steps)

The validation loss Megatron prints every 1,000 steps (Boxiang's packed validation set, with context; not the doc-isolated protocol above, so the levels do not compare). Each reading is one random draw of the validation set, noise sigma about 0.006 per reading: grey dots = single readings, line = mean of the last 5 readings within the same data phase; dotted line = the switch to the phase-2 data at step 58,000 (59.6 %). From step 40,000 (41.1 %) on.

Full evaluation scope

Full evaluation = the task list nvbench/cosmos_ultra_ladder.yml of the unified eval harness lm-evaluation-harness (branch ultra-prod): 36 tasks, 66 metrics, replacing nemo6's 40 tasks and 75 metrics. Prompt, few-shot examples, stops and answer reading of each task follow the benchmark's official implementation. Key evaluation = 19 of these tasks, one headline metric each (marked "key" in the tree below, headline metric in bold). Scores come from runs/cosmos_eval_downstream (since 11-12); the five math tasks (MATH-500 / Minerva / AIME 24 / AIME 25 / HMMT) from the re-run with the corrected math prompt; MiMo-V2.5-Pro-Base from the complete re-run with the end-of-document stop token. Scores of the earlier protocol (nemo6) are not comparable with this version and are no longer in the report.

External models not evaluated with this list yet (they only have scores of the earlier nemo6 protocol and are not in the tables below): DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base, Kimi-K3, Mistral-Large-4 (FP8).

Our own checkpoints are evaluated with the same list; their scores are in the "prod downstream" tab.

Non-generation benchmarks 13 tasks · 25 metrics

key = a task of the chapter "Full evaluation: key benchmarks"; its headline metric there is in bold. Generation modes: greedy = one greedy decode; 32 samples = 32 samples per item, pass@1 (mean of the 32) and pass@32 (any correct); sampled GPQA reports pass@1 and the majority vote (the most frequent answer of the 32). Code exec = the generated code runs the test cases. acc (ties shared) = an exact tie at the top counts 1/k.
